transcript.statement: Safety is paramount in any bookkeeping system to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial data. My requirements, such as SAF-01 ensuring accurate transaction recording and SAF-02 enforcing double-entry bookkeeping, are essential to prevent discrepancies and data loss. Additionally, SAF-03 mandates an audit trail for accountability, while SAF-04 addresses fault tolerance. Requirements SAF-05 and SAF-06 ensure that the system remains functional during outages and accurately validates currency conversions, respectively. Without these, the system's reliability is compromised.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure accurate recording of all financial transactions to prevent data loss and corruption.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 6 years to ensure accountability.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing, prioritizing critical transactions.
The system shall support safe degradation, ensuring essential functionalities are accessible during partial outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall support processing of financial transactions within 3 seconds during peak loads.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce latency by at least 50%.
The system shall ensure that currency conversion operations complete within 3 seconds for real-time transactions.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing using efficient algorithms.
The system shall implement user access controls to ensure only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud, prioritizing critical discrepancies.
The system shall ensure compliance with both financial regulations and sustainability standards.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on their roles.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
